enactment_authority: California Legislature, Civil Code of 1872 comprehensive codification (1870 Stats. ch. 516 Code Commission Act)
original_text_source: Codification histories in Deering's and West's Annotated California Civil Code § 3294 (enactment note '1872' with subsequent amendment history)
original_text_structure: Single unnumbered paragraph. No subdivisions, no internal definitions, no employer liability provision, no wrongful-death provision.
derivation: Codification of pre-existing California common-law exemplary damages doctrine. Common-law source: Wilkes v. Wood (1763) and Huckle v. Money (1763), imported via American common law into California by 1850 statehood. Field's Draft Civil Code of New York (1865) contained a similar provision that California adopted.
